commands:
for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto --dport ssh -j f2b-a
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-a
<iptables> -X f2b-a

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto --dport ssh -j f2b-a
done; done

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto -m multiport --dports ssh -j f2b-b
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-b
<iptables> -X f2b-b

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto -m multiport --dports ssh -j f2b-b
done; done
^[^[]*\[<HOST>\](?::\d+)?: SASL ((?i)LOGIN|PLAIN|(?:CRAM|DIGEST)-MD5) authentication failed:(?! Connection lost to authentication server| Invalid authentication mechanism)

nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'smtp,465,submission,imap,imaps,pop3,pop3s' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'smtp,465,submission,imap,imaps,pop3,pop3s' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'smtp,465,submission,imap,imaps,pop3,pop3s' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'smtp,465,submission,imap,imaps,pop3,pop3s' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'
^ LOG\d\[\d+:\d+\]:\ SSL_accept from <HOST>:\d+ : (?P<CODE>[\dA-F]+): error:(?P=CODE):SSL routines:SSL3_GET_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE:peer did not return a certificate$

if [ -n "" ] && ufw app info ""
then
ufw prepend reject from <ip> to any app "" comment "by Fail2Ban after <failures> attempts against stunnel"
else
ufw prepend reject from <ip> to any comment "by Fail2Ban after <failures> attempts against stunnel"
fi

if [ -n "" ] && ufw app info ""
then
ufw delete reject from <ip> to any app ""
else
ufw delete reject from <ip> to any
fi

files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
banaction_allports = nftables[type=allports]
usedns = no
ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8
[postfix-sasl]
enabled = true
backend = pyinotify
maxretry = 1_0
bantime = -1
findtime = 10m
usedns = raw
[apache-modsecurity]
enabled = true
backend = gamin
logpath = /nonexistent/%(__name__)s.log
bantime = 1y
action = iptables[name=a]
           iptables-multiport[name=b, port=ssh]
ignoreip = 
usedns = raw
[stunnel]
enabled = true
backend = pyinotify
logpath = /dev/null
maxretry = 1_0
bantime = -1
findtime = 1d
action = ufw
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=aggressive]

stderr:
fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING Have not found any log file for 'apache-modsecurity' jail.
fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING Have not found any log file for 'postfix-sasl' jail.
